name: Tsuruno Makiyo
source: The teacher of Ren's class and an English teacher who is popular with the students because of her kind and friendly personality. Her biggest weakness is money because of a debt her family had had when she was younger. Makiyo is also a friend of [url=/c35463]Miu's[/url]; they went to the same university.
